areas.coordinateCaution: Source area centroid only; not field verified. Source bbox/polygon is synthetic extent, not physical rock footprint.
areas.description:
Kraft Bouldering is one of the most accessible and highest quality crags the Southwest has to offer! There are hundreds of problems at Kraft and most are <15 minutes from your car! It can get crowded, but there's more than enough boulders to find something open if you want more space. It mainly has single digit boulders, but a handful of more advanced climbs as well.

Park in the Kraft Mountain Parking Lot or along the road below the lot if the lot is full (common). Heed parking signage and don't block driveways to preserve access to this awesome area, and please do not leave any waste or garbage at the boulders!

[NOTE - AREA SHOULD BE MOVED INTO CALICO BASIN BOULDERING]
